blockers.title: Bare verb + %x (and any non-q/Q designator) with a NON-PAIRING delimiter silently escapes when the rooted argv starts immediately after the delimiter
blockers.evidence: Detector (residueGemHits direct seam): `system %x|/usr/local/bin/x|` => 0 rows; `system %x!/usr/local/bin/x!` => 0; `system %W|/usr/local/bin/x|` => 0; `system %x%/usr/local/bin/x%` => 0. Box ruby 3.3.8 liveness (live.rb, per-case marker rm): %x|, %x!, %x%, %x@ under bare system ALL LIVE-EXECUTED the out-of-tree script (LIVE_EXECUTED marker touched each time); %W|/%i! raise ArgumentError (dead shapes, benign).
blockers.root_cause: The new gemVerbSpan percent branch (residueGem.ts:71-82) matches `system %`, so matchAll's lastIndex consumes the `%` of `%x` and the dedicated `%x[^A-Za-z0-9\s]` arm can never re-fire; its span INCLUDES the `%x<delim>` prefix (slice(verbEnd-1, j+1)), unlike the %x arm's delimiter-EXCLUDING slice (verbEnd, i) at :88 that anchors a leading `/` at `^`. Bracket-pairing delimiters survive via the boundary class [\s(\[{<]; `| ! % @ # -` etc. do not, and GEM_PERCENT_LITERAL expands only %q/%Q.
blockers.asymmetry_proof: `system(%x|/usr/local/bin/x|)` (parened) => 1 row — verb does not consume the `%`, matchAll re-finds `%x|`, slice excludes delimiters, `^`-anchored ROOTED fires; lone `x = %x|/usr/local/bin/x|` => 1 row. So ONLY the paren-less bare-verb spelling escapes — exactly the BLK-R3bF4-B class the round just widened (live, 0-row, unnamed). §8 item (9) names only `}`/`)`-adjacency; :1090 claims paren-less percent operands 'row' — false for this family.
blockers.suggested_fix: One-line: in the percent branch return the payload WITHOUT the `%<designator><delim>` prefix (mirror :88), or expand all %[a-zA-Z]? designator literals, or add `:`-free re-scan; pin `system %x!/usr/local/bin/x!` => 1.
